name: osho-whats-up
description: What's up ?: release notes window for any web app (React, Svelte, Tauri, HTML), a guard that asks for a note before production (git pre-push on a branch or a release tag, gh pr create), and the procedures to install it (with an atelier: the app in a browser on invented data) and to prepare each release (reader agent, notes to tick, a writer agent that captures the real app and animates the captures, previews).
